#!/bin/bash
# Usage: ./clean_repo.sh /path/to/repo

REPO="$1"
cd "$REPO" || exit

echo "=== Cleaning $REPO ==="
du -sh .

# Remove .git
if [ -d ".git" ]; then
    rm -rf .git
    echo "  Removed .git"
fi

# Remove build dirs
for d in node_modules target build dist out bin obj __pycache__ .pytest_cache .mypy_cache .ruff_cache venv .venv env .gradle; do
    if [ -d "$d" ]; then
        rm -rf "$d"
        echo "  Removed $d"
    fi
